repositories.name: ps5-linux-loader
repositories.contribution: No source reuse in this project.
repositories.coverage: README and current firmware/hardware matrix reviewed
repositories.summary: Linux boot loader and payload for PS5; README lists explicit supported firmware and model combinations.
repositories.firmware_claim: Project documentation lists Phat/Slim support through selected 13.60 builds and Pro support at 13.60; no 14.10 entry.

repositories.name: ps5-linux-image
repositories.license: No SPDX license declared by GitHub API
repositories.contribution: No source reuse; license must be reviewed before reuse.
repositories.coverage: Repository identity and README-level role reviewed
repositories.summary: Build automation for Linux distribution images used with the PS5 Linux work; packaging is not evidence of firmware exploit support.
repositories.firmware_claim: Firmware compatibility inherited from the loader/runtime combination; not independently specified here.

repositories.name: ps5-linux-patches
repositories.license: No SPDX license declared by GitHub API
repositories.contribution: No source reuse; license must be reviewed before reuse.
repositories.coverage: Repository identity and README-level role reviewed
repositories.summary: Kernel, graphics and device patches for the PS5 Linux stack. Patch applicability is version- and build-dependent.
repositories.firmware_claim: No general firmware range inferred from patch presence.

repositories.name: pLinux5-NG
repositories.contribution: No source reuse; README identifies derived loader code and separate inherited licensing.
repositories.coverage: README compatibility statements reviewed at pinned revision
repositories.summary: High-firmware Linux loader rework. README title advertises 8.xx–13.60, while its current warning says only 13.20 is supported.
repositories.firmware_claim: 13.20 is the explicit current supported version in the README; broader 8.xx–13.60 label is not an implemented compatibility guarantee.

repositories.name: PS5_Vulkan
repositories.contribution: No source reuse. README disclaims Khronos conformance; use upstream notices for any future dependency review.
repositories.coverage: README, roadmap, CTS caveats, dependency and license statements reviewed
repositories.summary: PS5-native graphics work: Mesa RADV port, earlier ps5vk driver, and hardware probe harness. Maintainer documents one-console measurements and open CTS gaps.
repositories.firmware_claim: No PS5 system firmware compatibility range is stated.

repositories.name: playden-ps5
repositories.contribution: No source reuse. Third-party runtime components have separate notices and licenses.
repositories.coverage: README, compatibility notes, runtime kit and third-party notices reviewed
repositories.summary: A console homebrew launcher with a Wine-based runtime kit; README documents DXVK, vkd3d-proton and Mesa dependencies and marks the project alpha.
repositories.firmware_claim: Release kit directory includes the label fw1360-dev1; installed console firmware support is not thereby established, and no 14.10 support is claimed.

repositories.name: ProsperoStore
repositories.contribution: No source reuse; third-party notices apply to bundled dependencies.
repositories.summary: Native PS5 homebrew catalog browser and application manager; it aggregates third-party applications.
repositories.firmware_claim: No explicit system firmware compatibility matrix found in the reviewed README.

repositories.name: PS5LM
repositories.contribution: No source reuse; dependencies are pinned and separately licensed.
repositories.coverage: Build documentation and dependency graph reviewed
repositories.summary: PS5 homebrew large-language-model application. Its build documentation names PS5_Vulkan/RADV, PS5 OpenGL, PS5 homebrew UI, and the payload SDK.
repositories.firmware_claim: No explicit system firmware compatibility range stated in reviewed build docs.

repositories.name: KytyPS5
repositories.license: GPL-2.0-only; preserves upstream MIT notice and third-party licenses
repositories.contribution: No source reuse. Review bundled dependency licenses separately.
repositories.coverage: README, issue templates, compatibility-list description and license reviewed
repositories.summary: Host-side PS5 translation layer for Windows and Linux, with experimental macOS support. Project reports game boot/in-game compatibility; no console firmware target is applicable to host execution.
repositories.firmware_claim: No PS5 firmware compatibility claim; host-side title emulation is distinct from PS5 homebrew support.

repositories.name: PS5_RetroArch
repositories.contribution: No source reuse; RetroArch core licenses remain distinct.
repositories.summary: Native PS5 RetroArch homebrew. Maintainer says the current graphics path uses PS5_Vulkan/RADV; core availability is application scope, not system firmware support.
repositories.firmware_claim: No explicit system firmware compatibility range stated in reviewed README.

repositories.name: ps5link-sdk
repositories.summary: Linker and small SDK aimed at native PS5 titles rather than payloads; README reports testing at 9.00 and marks other firmware untested.
repositories.firmware_claim: 9.00 author-reported test only; other versions untested in the reviewed README.

repositories.name: prosper
repositories.license: No SPDX license declared by GitHub API
repositories.contribution: No reuse; no license grant was identified.
repositories.coverage: README-level project-scope review; compatibility claims not independently reproduced
repositories.summary: Experimental user-space PS5-to-PC compatibility-layer project, distinct from Wine/Proton on console Linux. The README itself says it is not a general-purpose game runner.
repositories.firmware_claim: No PS5 firmware compatibility claim; host-side execution is the stated target.

repositories.name: dxvk
repositories.coverage: Upstream project identity and license metadata recorded
repositories.summary: Wine Vulkan translation implementation for Direct3D 8–11; relevant only where a compatible Wine and Vulkan stack exists.

repositories.name: vkd3d-proton
repositories.coverage: Upstream project identity and license metadata recorded
repositories.summary: Proton's Direct3D 12 to Vulkan implementation; PS5 runtime suitability depends on the Vulkan and Wine ports.

capabilities.notes: This console-side compatibility stack is separate from desktop Proton on Linux and separate from the project's Freedom OS goals unless a user-mode compatibility layer is intentionally selected.
